notes.text: VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a local privilege escalation vulnerability.  A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools  installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.
